outcome: Safety (perforation, pelvic infection, excessive bleeding, unusual vaginal discharge, pain abdomen)
Efficacy (expulsion, pregnancy with IUCD in situ)
cohort: The study included 200 women delivering vaginally or by caesarian section who were counselled for PPIUCD antenatally, in early labour, or in the immediate postpartum period.
finding: The study found high rates of safety and continuation for PPIUCD, with 93.3% of women having no complications at 6 months, and common complications being heavy menstrual bleeding (5.5%) and pain abdomen (1.2%), and an expulsion rate of 1.7% at 3 months.
